body:
Upgrade antigravity-booster for strict conformance with Google Antigravity Plugin Marketplace (agy >= 1.4.11):
1. Update plugin.json with displayName ('Antigravity Booster'), search-optimized description, logo ('assets/logo.svg'), suggestedPrompts (3 zero-friction starter prompts for /agb-doctor, /agb-plan, /agb-review), homepage ('https://www.agybooster.com'), and repository ('https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster').
2. Create assets/logo.svg (256x256 square vector badge, transparent canvas, >=10% outer margin, high contrast for light/dark themes).
3. Create rules/AGENTS.md with concise always-on session orchestration guidance for mcp__agb__* tools and /agb-* skills.
4. Expose all 7 user-facing slash commands (agb-bootstrap, agb-doctor, agb-migrate, agb-plan, agb-review, agb-run, agb-sidecar) as native Antigravity plugin skills in skills/<name>/SKILL.md and sync to .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
5. Update parseValidateOutput and validateBooster in lib/migrate.mjs (and rebuild dist/agb.mjs) to parse both legacy agy 1.2.x ('✔ <cat> : <n> processed') and agy 1.4.x ('skills <n> · agents <n> · ...') output formats without failing when 'commands' is omitted in agy 1.4.x.
6. Add scripts/stage-marketplace-plugin.mjs and npm script 'plugin:validate' to stage a clean Marketplace plugin bundle + marketplace.json catalog and verify agy plugin validate --strict --json passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 notes.
7. Update package.json files array to include assets/ and rules/, and add tests in test/plugin-layout.test.mjs and test/migrate-rollback.test.mjs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- `node --test test/plugin-layout.test.mjs test/commands.test.mjs test/migrate-rollback.test.mjs test/packaging.test.mjs` exits 0.
- `node scripts/stage-marketplace-plugin.mjs --validate-strict` exits 0 with 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes.
title: Antigravity Plugin Marketplace packaging, discovery metadata, native skills, and agy 1.4.x validator support
